symptom: `create or modify microflow` that changed one show message's text reported `spliced: 1 edited in place`, and the message kept only en_US; its nl_NL translation was deleted. Measured on Administration.ChangePassword of the 11.12.6 blank project.
cause: The in-place edit serializes the activity from the statement (one language per text) and saves through UpdateRawUnitPatch, which passes ContentsOwnTranslations, so canon's translation carry never runs on it. Other unstatable properties of an edited activity already had their own carry (carryUnstated, #2169); translations had none.
insight: **A patch write opts out of every canon carry, so each thing a splice rebuilds from MDL needs its own.** The splice writes as a patch on purpose (a carry would undo a deliberate removal), but its in-place edit is a rebuild of one activity; it gets canon.CarryTranslations applied to that activity alone (stored activity vs replacement, paired by path), then unmarkRemoved on the result so the carried stored translation elements are not refused as removed. Control: an edit of the only language lands unchanged; without the carry the nl_NL assertion fails.
